# Entitlements matrix

Status: draft
Owner: Director, CPS Research Programs

What each principal's ecosystem may use. Anything not listed is denied (default posture
`deny`). An entitlement lets a principal *dispatch* work; it never grants a
protected effect. Protected effects need a decision record from a principal holding that decision right.
